part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-01-struc.ko: SCM의 endogenous·exogenous 변수·structural equation·noise 분포를 구분한다. 부모 관계로 causal graph를 구성하고 equation과 noise 분포로 관찰 분포를 설명하며 neural causal node의 변수 선택을 다룬다.
part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-01-struc.en: Distinguish endogenous and exogenous variables, structural equations, and noise distributions in SCMs. Construct graphs from parent relations, explain observational distributions generated by equations and noise, and specify variables for neural causal nodes.

part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-02-do-op.ko: conditioning과 structural equation을 교체하는 do intervention을 비교한다. 간단한 DAG에 truncated factorization을 적용하고 activation patch의 source·target·alignment policy를 명시한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-02-do-op.en: Compare conditioning with do interventions that replace structural equations. Apply truncated factorization to simple DAGs and specify activation-patch source, target, and alignment policies.

part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-03-confo.ko: graph에서 confounder·mediator·collider를 구분하고 backdoor adjustment를 적용한다. 구조적 identifiability와 통계적 추정, 내부 개입의 직접 실행과 관찰 identification의 역할을 나눠 설명한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-03-confo.en: Distinguish confounders, mediators, and colliders in graphs and apply backdoor adjustment. Separate structural identifiability from estimation and direct internal-intervention execution from observational identification.

part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-04-media.ko: total·natural direct·natural indirect effect를 potential outcome으로 표현한다. mediator conditioning과 개입, cross-world·no-confounding 가정을 구분하고 neural patching의 interaction·off-manifold 문제를 진단한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-04-media.en: Express total, natural direct, and natural indirect effects through potential outcomes. Distinguish mediator conditioning from intervention, examine cross-world and no-confounding assumptions, and diagnose interaction and off-manifold issues in patching.

part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-05-count.ko: 같은 unit의 potential outcome 차이로 individual·average treatment effect를 정의한다. consistency·no interference·exchangeability와 abduction–action–prediction을 설명하고 내부 실행의 pairing 조건을 점검한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-05-count.en: Define individual and average treatment effects through same-unit potential-outcome contrasts. Examine consistency, no interference, exchangeability, and abduction–action–prediction, checking pairing conditions for internal runs.

part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-06-causa.ko: low-level state와 high-level variable을 잇는 abstraction map과 개입 대응을 정의한다. commuting condition·근사 오차·held-out 개입을 검사해 decoding 정확도와 구현 관계의 증거를 구분한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-06-causa.en: Define abstraction maps from low-level states to high-level variables and corresponding interventions. Test commuting conditions, approximation error, and held-out interventions to distinguish decoding accuracy from evidence of implementation.

part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-07-exter.ko: source·target population의 내부 개입 효과와 covariate shift의 transport 조건을 구분한다. support overlap·effect heterogeneity를 검사하고 prompt·seed·checkpoint·architecture 밖 주장의 범위를 제한한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-07-exter.en: Distinguish source and target population intervention effects and transport conditions under covariate shift. Check support overlap and effect heterogeneity, bounding claims beyond tested prompts, seeds, checkpoints, and architectures.

part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-08-capst.ko: circuit 가설을 SCM·potential outcome과 연결해 node·path 개입·matched control을 설계한다. necessity·sufficiency·mediation·abstraction의 held-out 증거를 분리해 내부·행동·외적 주장을 작성한다.
part-4-advanced/A09-CAU/A09-CAU-08-capst.en: Connect circuit hypotheses to SCMs and potential outcomes to design node/path interventions and matched controls. Separate held-out necessity, sufficiency, mediation, and abstraction evidence when writing internal, behavioral, and external claims.
